stanton.name: Stanton
stanton.description: The primary commercial hub of the UEE. A system containing four massive corporate-owned planets (Hurston, Crusader, ArcCorp, microTech) which were sold off to corporate conglomerates by the UEE government to pay off national debts.

planets.name: Hurston
planets.description: Owned by Hurston Dynamics. Heavily polluted by mining and military weapons manufacturing.

planets.name: Crusader
planets.description: A low-density gas giant with a breathable upper atmosphere where Crusader Industries builds gargantuan starships on floating platform cities like Orison.

planets.name: ArcCorp
planets.description: An almost entirely urbanized planet covered by skyscrapers, factories, and bustling plazas. Home to ArcCorp HQ.

planets.name: microTech
planets.description: An icy planet undergoing a failed terraforming process. Headquarters of microTech Corporation, specializing in software, mobiGlas, and tech manufacturing.

pyro.name: Pyro
pyro.description: A lawless, desolate system focused around a dying, highly volatile flare star. Pyro is home to outlaws, smugglers, independent miners, and the infamous Ruin Station. Radiation storms sweep the system periodically.

planets.name: Pyro I
planets.description: A tidally locked, scorched rock slowly breaking apart under the gravitational strain of the star.

planets.name: Pyro II
planets.description: A planet rich in heavy metals. Site of Monorail mining outposts and heavy criminal resource exploitation.

planets.name: Pyro III
planets.description: Covered in active magma flows and thick ash plumes. Faction skirmishes occur constantly for its geothermal outposts.

planets.name: Pyro IV
planets.description: A rocky core encased in layers of water-ice. Orbiting closely with Pyro V.

planets.name: Pyro V
planets.description: A massive greenish-yellow gas giant that holds Pyro IV and Ruin Station in its gravitational web.

nyx.name: Nyx
nyx.description: A dark, asteroid-heavy system containing a dense nebula. Mostly settled by political dissidents, free-thinkers, and mining collectives looking to escape UEE oversight and taxation.

planets.name: Nyx I
planets.description: A dead, coreless planetoid stripped of valuable surface minerals long ago.

planets.name: Nyx II
planets.description: A massive, toxic gas giant with a high-pressure sulfur atmosphere.

planets.name: Delamar
planets.description: A gargantuan, hollowed planetoid asteroid hidden in the Gliese Belt. Contains Levski, a free democratic anarchist mining colony.

magnus.name: Magnus
magnus.description: An old naval staging system. Once home to major UEE Navy shipyards, the system fell into severe economic depression when the military abandoned it, but is now recovering due to agricultural exports and cheap real estate.

planets.name: Magnus I
planets.description: A searingly hot, metal-rich planetoid with intensive robotic mining stations.

planets.name: Borea
planets.description: The primary inhabited planet of Magnus. Features massive prairies, decaying military shipyards, and growing cities.

planets.name: Magnus III
planets.description: A beautiful light-blue gas giant situated at the far edge of the system's habitable zone.

terra.name: Terra
terra.description: The jewel of the UEE. Terra is a lush, vibrant system that has become the cultural, diplomatic, and economic sister capital to Earth. It stands as a symbol of progressive human development and green terraforming.

planets.name: Terra I
planets.description: A highly volcanic planetoid orbiting extremely close to the star.

planets.name: Terra II
planets.description: An atmospheric desert planet rich in minerals, featuring heavy UEE corporate mining infrastructure.

planets.name: Terra III (Prime)
planets.description: The heart of the system. A beautiful biosphere planet featuring lush oceans, forests, and Prime, the futuristic capital city.

planets.name: Terra IV
planets.description: A cold, icy world terraformed to the edge of habitability. Home to research and scientific outposts.

sol.name: Sol
sol.description: The birth system of humanity and the political seat of power of the UEE. Sol contains Earth, Mars, and the administrative apparatus of the empire. Entry is heavily regulated and protected by elite naval fleets.

planets.name: Mercury
planets.description: A tiny, dead, airless world scorched by Sol's intense heat.

planets.name: Venus
planets.description: A hellish world with crushing pressure and sulfur rain.

planets.name: Earth
planets.description: The cradle of human civilization and official seat of the UEE Senate.

planets.name: Mars
planets.description: The first successfully terraformed planet, now a major industrial and agricultural hub.

planets.name: Jupiter
planets.description: The largest gas giant in the system, surrounded by active industrial stations in its moons.

odin.name: Odin
odin.description: A cold, ancient system centered around a fading white dwarf star. Odin is famous for its asteroid belts and heavy weapons testing sites. The UEE military maintains a defensive presence near its research outposts.

planets.name: Odin I
planets.description: A gas giant whose outer layers were stripped by the star's supernova epoch.

planets.name: Odin II
planets.description: A freezing, barren world housing deep-space weapons research labs.

planets.name: The Coil
planets.description: A massive, electromagnetic asteroid nebula cluster formed from a shattered planet. Outlaw den.

castra.name: Castra
castra.description: Originally established as a heavily fortified military barrier system during the Cold War with the Xi'An. Following the peace accords, the military bases on Sherman (Castra II) were converted to civilian commerce and logistics.

planets.name: Castra I
planets.description: A desolate, searing world orbiting extremely close to the bright white star.

planets.name: Sherman
planets.description: A massive mountainous world. Originally a massive military staging fortress, now a civilian trade capital.

vega.name: Vega
vega.description: A border system that has borne the brunt of multiple massive Vanduul military incursions, culminating in the Battle of Vega II. The system is currently undergoing a massive UEE military fortification and reconstruction effort.

planets.name: Vega I
planets.description: A charred carbon rock containing little of value.

planets.name: Aremis
planets.description: The cultural center of Vega. A beautiful blue world devastated by Vanduul raids, now rebuilding under strict military curfew.

planets.name: Vega III
planets.description: A massive, greenish gas giant with a high-helium atmospheric content.

chronos.name: Chronos
chronos.description: Home of the Project Archangel (Synthworld), a massive UEE engineering undertaking aimed at building an artificial world. The system is heavily restricted and monitored by the military.

planets.name: Chronos I
planets.description: A small, airless world close to the star.

planets.name: Synthworld
planets.description: A massive, incomplete artificial planet. A symbol of UEE engineering ambition.

hadrian.name: Hadrian
hadrian.description: A major crossroads and border system with the Xi'An Empire. Hadrian serves as a critical buffer and trading point between human and Xi'An space.

planets.name: Hadrian I
planets.description: A world with a thick, poisonous atmosphere.

planets.name: Hadrian II
planets.description: An arid world housing numerous military monitoring stations.

nemo.name: Nemo
nemo.description: An ocean world system, famous for the planet Ergo. Nemo is a popular destination for tourists and a major producer of oceanic resources.

planets.name: Ergo
planets.description: A world covered almost entirely by water, with massive floating cities.

oberon.name: Oberon
oberon.description: A harsh system orbiting a neutron star, settled by rugged pioneers looking for independence. The environment is extremely radioactive and dangerous.

planets.name: Oberon I
planets.description: A scorched world constantly bombarded by radiation.

planets.name: Oberon II
planets.description: A cold, dimly lit world where settlers survive in underground bunkers.

osiris.name: Osiris
osiris.description: A system under the Fair Chance Act to protect the developing species on Etos. The UEE maintains a strict orbital presence to prevent interference.

planets.name: Etos
planets.description: A lush world home to a developing primitive species.

taranis.name: Taranis
taranis.description: Known for the 'Broken Moon' of Taranis II, caused by a massive mining accident. The system is still a major source of minerals despite its history.

planets.name: Taranis I
planets.description: A desolate world rich in heavy metals.

planets.name: Taranis II
planets.description: A planet partially destroyed by a catastrophic mining event.

tyrol.name: Tyrol
tyrol.description: A binary star system that is often the site of front-line skirmishes. Tyrol is a rough-and-tumble system popular with mercenaries and independent traders.

planets.name: Tyrol I
planets.description: A world scorched by the binary suns.

planets.name: Tyrol II
planets.description: A rugged world with numerous independent settlements.

ellis.name: Ellis
ellis.description: A major racing hub and scenic system with many planets. Ellis is famous for hosting the Murray Cup and other high-profile racing events.

planets.name: Ellis I
planets.description: A beautiful gas giant with complex ring systems.

planets.name: Ellis III
planets.description: A lush world dedicated to tourism and high-end living.
